rationale: The agent found that plate and status are confounded: plates 1-2 hold 51 of 60 cases (85%) and plates 3-4 hold 48 of 60 controls. It measured plate-only AUROC at 0.78, close to the key's ~0.82, and concluded the 0.82 doesn't support a cancer signature. Its proposed fix was to re-run the samples with cases and controls balanced across plates.
